summary: Practise NGO request triage, safe referrals and support follow-up using CHS, Sphere and IASC guidance. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Donor and beneficiary support for NGOs helps support officers and programme teams handle requests, concerns and inquiries through safe, accountable follow-up. For NGO support officers, programme coordinators and accountability focal points, the course develops practical skills in triaging cases, routing referrals, protecting sensitive records and tracking responses through closure.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who respond to beneficiary requests, donor questions and service concerns within NGO programmes. It suits foundation-level learners who need clear, safe procedures for receiving, recording, routing and following up on support cases.
modules: Sphere Handbook and Safe Service Access
IASC AAP Feedback and Response Channels
Donor Inquiry Triage and Service Commitments
prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is assumed. Familiarity with NGO programmes, beneficiary-facing services or donor support processes is useful; no coding is required.
